verdict: No. v2 did not clear 8/10. Mean of the five personas across all fifteen axes is 7.61. Only 5 of 15 axes are at 8.0 or above: jev_showcase 9.0, inventiveness 8.6, use_of_the_evidence 8.4, elegance 8.2, differentiation 8.2. Ten axes are still below 8, and the two lowest are the ones that decide the room: does_it_work_in_8_hours 6.4 and, tied at 6.6, would_my_audience_use_it and onboarding_lightness. The pattern is unambiguous and it is not fifteen separate problems: every low axis traces to one of four root causes. (1) The two headline numbers are authored, not discovered — three of five personas independently found `how_she_decides` in engine_basket.py and `captions_long_form` in engine_onboarding.py and called it the same sin the team already retracted once. (2) There is no creator-side loop, so Maya's 70 hours are untouched and nobody presses send. (3) The product still only wakes when someone sends a DM, which leaves out the 61% of buyers who never message — the exact person the demo script is named after. (4) The repo is a v2 idea with v1 documents: docs/03-build-plan.md and docs/07-demo-script.md still describe the 359-tile wall, and design/ is empty. Two persona complaints are already stale and should be corrected on stage, not conceded: scripts/engine_overnight_queue.py (the confidence-gated overnight triage, 47 DMs including medical cases it refuses) and scripts/engine_sharecard.py (the same shared card re-deciding for four different receivers) exist and run — they are untracked in git, which is why three reviewers said the queue and the share loop do not exist. Commit them first thing. Fix the four root causes and every axis clears 8; the arithmetic below allocates 12.75 person-hours of the ~16.5 available before a 14:30 freeze, which leaves real slack.

remaining_gaps.why: Four of five personas checked the repo rather than the pitch. docs/03-build-plan.md still opens on "THE FENCE" and cache/fence.json; docs/07-demo-script.md still opens Beat 1 on "Three hundred and fifty-nine real skincare products" — the thing you cut. design/ is empty. Meanwhile v2 promises card + permalink + share image + persisted drag handle + onboarding + private/public modes + blocklist + safety gate + inbox. This axis went DOWN from v1 (7 to 6.4), which is the only axis that regressed, and it regressed because the documents now contradict the product.
remaining_gaps.the_fix: Before anyone writes frontend: 40 minutes rewriting docs/03-build-plan.md and docs/07-demo-script.md to v2, and freeze the build to exactly three URL shapes — /c/<id> (verdict card, which is also the share image), /ask (three taps, public), /maya (her queue), plus /onboard as a strip on top of /maya. Anything not reachable from those paths is out today; private/public and the blocklist become config flags on the card record, not screens. Then at H+5.0 every measured result (12 DMs, 6 shoppers x 2 judges, 9 values, the band, the queue stats, 4 share cards) is frozen to cache/*.json and the live engine writes into the same shape, so venue wifi degrades the demo to "pre-computed" instead of a spinner.
remaining_gaps.hours: 0.5h docs + scope freeze, 0.5h static fallback path — saves ~3h of build risk

remaining_gaps.why: Three personas independently opened engine_onboarding.py and found the answer key in the input: captions_long_form contains "non negotiable, I will die on this hill" (= spf), "it is not 62 pounds good" (= price_sensitive), "you don't need eight steps" (= routine_length), "stop adding things, take things away" (= subtraction), and her creed verbatim. Eight sentences the team typed. The ONE value not written into the input — asks_before_advising — is the ONE value it got wrong. Recovery on unseen signal is 0/1, not 89%. Worse, the adoption critic found it feeds nothing: engine_basket.py hard-codes ROUTING and engine_dm_router.py reads P["decision_rules"] straight from the private case file, so for any creator who is not Maya, pasting a link produces a report no engine consumes.
remaining_gaps.the_fix: One file, one direction. engine_onboarding.py writes data/standard-maya.json (the 9 typed values + the source caption each was inferred from + confidence). engine_basket.py and engine_dm_router.py read ONLY that file — delete the six hand-written how_she_decides bullets and stop reading decision_rules from the private case. Then publish the degradation curve honestly: run (a) current captions, (b) captions with every explicit standard-statement stripped to real GRWM-style titles, (c) a real scraped feed if you get one — report N/9 for each even if (b) is 5/9. Gate on it: under 6 of 9 above the confidence floor, the UI says "your feed doesn't say enough yet" and hands her the 40-second voice prompt already verified in voice_to_judgement.py. Rename public_comments_she_left to questions_her_audience_sends_her — it is her inbox, not her voice, and one judge opening that file turns the honesty story inside out.

remaining_gaps.why: Priya's line: "You named me in your demo script and then built a machine that only speaks when spoken to." Every path in v2 begins with an incoming DM. 61% of buyers (E-09.2) never send one, E-10's Rina/Tara/Zoe have 0 DMs and 8-11 saves, and the median purchase lag is 4.6 days (E-09.5). The router literally emits the route "PRICE CEILING + watch" and nothing watches.
remaining_gaps.the_fix: Two things, both reusing code that already runs. (1) /ask — one public link for her bio, three chip taps (skin: 5 chips / budget: 3 chips / how many: 1, 2, a few), no text box, card in under six seconds, free-text box as the fallback that goes through engine_dm_router.py. (2) Every card re-decides when it is OPENED, not when it was sent: same enumeration, sub-second, and the card says either "still the same two things, go" or "one change — the Red Reset is the one to move on now." That is Maya's payday idea stripped of all scheduling infrastructure, and engine_sharecard.py already proves the same card resolves differently per opener. Plus a Save button writing the card id to the phone.
remaining_gaps.hours: 2h (chip intake reusing the router's extracted fields + re-decide-on-open)

remaining_gaps.why: Maya, twice now: the only thing that touches her 70 hours is a morning approval queue, and the word "approve" appears nowhere in v2. Twelve DMs classify in 0.68 seconds and then nothing says who presses send. Her exact words: "If it sends by itself I am terrified; if it does not, I still typed 4,800 replies this month." The judge adds a second half: the nine typed values are a printout, not a control panel.
remaining_gaps.the_fix: /maya, one screen, and most of it already exists uncommitted. engine_overnight_queue.py already triages 47 DMs on five judgments each and sorts them into answered / asked-back / held / refused-and-referred, with medical cases correctly escalated. Put a stack of cards on top of it: drafted reply, confidence, three buttons (send, edit, hold), anything under the gate pre-held, header reading "you approved 30 replies in 4 minutes." Every edit writes back into data/standard-maya.json, so correcting a reply moves the standard. Strip the nine values across the top as tappable switches, each quoting the caption it came from — she corrects, she does not author, and flipping one re-decides the next card in under a second.

remaining_gaps.why: Two separate holes. First, three personas will ask the same Q&A question: MAYA's judge state says in your handwriting "Fewer steps beats more steps" and "She does NOT spend the whole budget" while DERM's says "Builds a complete evidence-based routine" and carries no budget discipline and no routing rules — so "0.7 fewer products, £14 less" is arithmetic on two paragraphs you typed, and the 5-of-6 divergence is guaranteed by construction. It is the identical failure you publicly retracted in §2b. Second, nothing human sits between her standard and a stranger's face except the confidence gate.
remaining_gaps.the_fix: Give the dermatologist a symmetric state: the same six decision slots, filled clinically, INCLUDING a budget line and its own routing rules, and build Maya's side only from data/standard-maya.json. Re-run the six shoppers and publish whatever divergence survives — if it drops to 3 of 6, say 3 of 6 on stage. A defended 3/6 beats an undefended 5/6 and it is the same lesson that bought the credibility you currently have. Then one sentence on stage, in the runbook, in the README: "it never sends, it drafts" — everything in her voice passes the queue.

remaining_gaps.why: Maya's "still_wrong", and she is right: the onboarding prints category_she_defends = spf at confidence 1.00, and then the headline table sends Emily (22, £40, combination) a moisturiser and NO SPF while the dermatologist you are beating sends her the SPF. E-04.5 says "Non-negotiable" and rates it 9.6. A system that learned the rule, printed the rule, then broke the rule in the slide is a clever ranker with her face on it — and a judge reading the table finds it before the sentence ends.
remaining_gaps.the_fix: Non-negotiables become hard constraints, not preferences. In feasible(), drop any basket that omits a defended category — unless the shopper already owns it, or the budget cannot reach it, in which case the card says so in words: "SPF first, everything else after." It is a filter over the enumeration you already have plus one sentence of copy, and the filter is populated from the extracted standard, not typed in, so it also proves the extraction is load-bearing. Re-run the six shoppers until Emily's row shows SPF.

remaining_gaps.why: Up from 3 to 7.4, the biggest move on the sheet, and it stalls for one reason: the card is a design. Priya — "not a 9 because I have still never seen one — it's a spec, not a screen." Tano adds that you gave her the ability to share and not the reason: nobody forwards a basket, people forward a verdict and a number.
remaining_gaps.the_fix: Build the share image FIRST and make /c/<id> a rendering of the same component, so there is no code path where the card exists and the image does not. One 1080x1350 OG image per card id, served as og:image so it previews inside iMessage and WhatsApp without the receiver opening anything (which is what makes the 41% dark-social path observable, because parent_card_id rides the previewed link). On the image: the refusal and the money, not the basket — "A dermatologist would sell you 3 things for £72. Maya says one. £26." Plus one button on a received card, "do it for me instead", which re-runs the engine with the receiver's constraints and mints a child card with parent_card_id set. engine_sharecard.py already measures that re-decide working across four receivers.

remaining_gaps.why: Maya, second review running: "nobody has written the word affiliate." Confirmed — it appears once in the whole repo, in a data field in eval_coldstart.py. If this sends people to buy and her tag is not on the link, you built a free conversion funnel for brands and paid for it with her credibility. And Tano sells to BRANDS: there is currently nothing in the product a brand buys.
remaining_gaps.the_fix: Two small things. (1) One money line on every product row, always, in plain words: "Maya earns nothing on this one" or "affiliate link — she earns if you buy", plus a running basket-value figure in the card footer. One field on the product record and a line of copy, and Priya values it above the entire speed section. (2) One pre-rendered brand screen for Tano: put a real brief through her standard and show the verdict, the defended ceiling, and the one objection she would say on camera that the brand will not like — then show the blocklist suppressing that verdict from the public card. Declining the sale in front of the buyer, safely, is the most Tano thing anyone will do on that stage.
remaining_gaps.hours: 0.75h money line + 0.75h brand screen (pre-rendered, one Jev call) = 1.5h

remaining_gaps.why: Priya, twice: @gracelee ("dry skin + redness, £60") and Priya ("my face freaks out") both get Red Reset + SPF 50 at £58. Identical string. You measured a real irritation axis off 198 real ingredient lists — Acnemix 0.92, L'Oreal Revitalift LASER 0.85, Cetaphil 0.25, mineral SPF 0.37 — and it never touched a basket. If the two rows are the same text at demo time, the personalisation claim is false and it is falsifiable from your own table.
remaining_gaps.the_fix: Wire the irritation score into feasibility as a hard filter, not a display field: for a shopper who says their skin reacts, any basket containing a product above ~0.6 irritation is infeasible. Then one sentence on the card explaining the swap — "Red Reset is in because it's fragrance-free; the Cloud Cream is out because of the essential oils" — and re-run the six shoppers until Priya's basket diverges from @gracelee's.
remaining_gaps.hours: 1h (same filter mechanism as the SPF constraint above)

remaining_gaps.why: Three mechanisms (12 DMs, basket divergence, paste-a-link) competing for the same 90 seconds, and the written demo still spends its first 25 seconds on a grid of 359 tiles and a cost counter — the exact thing four personas asked you to cut. Worse, the spine rests on the divergence stat, which is the number most likely to be challenged in Q&A.
remaining_gaps.the_fix: Open cold on a refusal, not a proof: @jessica's real DM read out loud, then the card that says "no, you don't need the barrier cream, just the SPF, £26" against the dermatologist's £72. A real message, a machine declining to sell, and £46 saved, inside fifteen seconds. Every throughput number — 2,535/sec, 530 judgments, 0.68s — becomes ONE line of text under the split screen in the last ten seconds, after they already want it. And build in one unscripted beat where Maya, in the room, flips a switch and an open card re-decides live.

best_new_ideas: KEEP — THE UNSOLD RECEIPT (Priya + the adoption critic proposed the same object independently, which is the strongest signal in the returns). Every card carries the difference between the two baskets you already compute as a struck-through line: "A dermatologist would have sold you 3 things for £70. She's sending you 2 for £58." It is pure arithmetic over cached judgments, it makes the card legible to a receiver who has never heard of Maya (it explains who she is without a bio), and it is the most screenshot-able sentence in the product. Aggregate it on her public page: "Maya's audience has been told not to spend £14,320 this month." No brand-funded creator tool will ever display that metric, which is exactly why it is hers. CONDITIONAL on the symmetric-derm fix landing first — without it the receipt is arithmetic on a straw man. 1h on top of the share image.

KEEP — THE INDIFFERENCE BAND (the judge). You already enumerate every feasible basket at one budget; sweep the budget too (£30/40/50/60/80/100) and find where the winning basket CHANGES. The card then prices its own answer: "Her answer is the same anywhere from £48 to £79. Spending £31 more buys you nothing. Below £48 she drops the Red Reset, not the SPF." ~6x the judgments, which at 2,535/sec is under two seconds and pennies. It is the one sentence a quiz structurally cannot produce, it is the proof the combinatorics are real rather than theatre, and "don't spend more, it doesn't change her answer" is the most trustworthy sentence in commerce. 0.5h.

KEEP — RE-DECIDE ON OPEN (Maya's payday idea, stripped of infrastructure). Do not build scheduling, notifications or a price-watch service. Instead every card re-enumerates when it is opened — four days later, on payday, from a friend's forward — and shows either "still the same two things, go" or "one change — the Red Reset is the one to move on now." Same engine, sub-second, zero new mechanism, and it answers E-09.5's 4.6-day lag without a cron job. Folded into the /ask + card work, ~0.25h marginal.

KEEP — THE RECEIVER'S OWN ANSWER (the judge's "do it for me instead"). One button on a received card re-runs the basket engine with the receiver's constraints and mints a child card carrying parent_card_id. This turns a forward from a screenshot into a generative event and makes the 41% dark-social path observable and measurable rather than asserted. engine_sharecard.py already measures it working: the same card resolves to different baskets for a sensitive sender, her oily student sister, her dry mature mum and a colleague who already owns the SPF. 0.75h to put a button on measured behaviour.

KEEP (REDUCED) — THE STANDARD INDEX, as exactly one pre-rendered screen (Tano). Do not build the 4,000-creator index. Put ONE real brief through Maya's extracted standard live: would she take it, what would she defend it at, and what is the one thing she would say on camera that the brand will not like — then show the blocklist suppressing that verdict from the public card. It reuses the ceiling engine with no new primitive, and it is the only beat that speaks directly to the people paying for the room. 0.75h.

DISCARD — the price-drop trigger with a fake clock (adoption critic) and the scheduled payday wake-up (Maya). Re-decide-on-open delivers the same demo beat with none of the clock-faking or scheduling, and a staged price drop invites the question "is that real?" at the worst possible moment.

DISCARD — the readiness meter and the leave-one-out-at-n curve (adoption critic). Correct instinct, but it is a second measurement programme and today is a build day. The honest degradation curve (a/b/c feeds) plus the voice gate covers the same worry in 45 minutes.

DISCARD — the aggregate 'trust delta' dashboard across all creators and the weekly artefact. Both require volume the product will not have by 20:00. Ship the single-creator running total on her public page as one number and say the aggregate in a sentence.

DISCARD — a real Instagram scraper (Tano, Priya). Instagram is login-walled and a live fetch failing on stage kills the onboarding beat outright. Ship paste-or-prefetch with an honest on-screen label and the raw text shown next to the extracted values, and publish the degraded-feed number instead. Honesty here is cheaper AND scores higher than a fetch that might work.
DISCARD — native share sheet and camera capture (Priya). Real gaps, wrong day. The OG preview image inside iMessage/WhatsApp gets ~80% of the value for a fraction of the build.

DISCARD — the draggable price line as a UI object (carried over from v1). Superseded by the nine tappable switches, which do the same job (her hand on the machine), are cheaper to build, and are the thing that proves the extraction is wired in.

H+5.5 · FEATURE FREEZE (14:30). Nothing new after this line. H+5.5 → H+6.5: all three, copy pass and end-to-end walk of the three routes on a real phone. Maya arrives 17:00 — put a card in her hand before she is asked anything, and let her flip a switch on the demo machine so the unscripted beat is rehearsed with her, not at her.

ACCOUNTING: 12.75 person-hours of build against ~16.5 available before the 14:30 freeze for three people. The 3.75h of slack is deliberate — v1's lesson was that the unbuilt hero dies at 19:00. WHAT IS CUT AND WHY: the 359-tile wall (it is one spoken line now); the draggable price line (superseded by the nine switches, which prove more for less); private/public as UI (config flag); a live Instagram scraper (login-walled, and failing on stage is fatal — paste-or-prefetch with an honest label instead); native share sheet and camera (real gaps, wrong day); price alerts, cron and the payday wake (re-decide-on-open is the same beat for free); the readiness meter and the LOO-at-n curve (a second measurement programme); the cross-creator trust-delta dashboard (no volume by 20:00, say it in a sentence). IF YOU FALL BEHIND, cut in this order: the brand screen, then 'do it for me instead', then the indifference band. NEVER cut, in any circumstance: the decontamination (H+0.5), the symmetric derm (H+0.5), the hard constraints (H+1.25) or the queue (H+2.0) — those four are the difference between 7.61 and 8+.
demo_beats: 0:00–0:14 — OPEN COLD ON A REFUSAL, NO SETUP. Read @jessica's real DM off the screen: "i already have the night serum. do i need the barrier cream too???" The card resolves live: NO. You don't need it. Just the SPF — about £26. Beside it, the dermatologist's answer for the same shopper: three products, £72. Say it once: "It just talked itself out of forty-six pounds of somebody's money." (No wall. No cost counter. No 'hi we're team X'.)

0:14–0:28 — THE DIVERGENCE. Same shelf, same six real shoppers, two columns. Maya's column is shorter and cheaper on every row. State the measured number as it comes out of the symmetric run — "on N of six shoppers she disagrees with a board-certified dermatologist" — then the averages: she sends fewer products and spends less of your money. Then the line that proves it is not a ranker: "Her answer doesn't change anywhere between forty-eight and seventy-nine pounds. Spending thirty-one more buys you nothing. Below forty-eight she drops the moisturiser, never the SPF."

biggest_remaining_risk: The headline is authored, and you have until roughly 11:00 to make it discovered. Three of five personas — including the judge who explicitly says \"I read the code, not the slide\" — independently opened engine_basket.py and engine_onboarding.py and found the same thing: MAYA's judge state contains \"Fewer steps beats more steps\" and \"She does NOT spend the whole budget\" in your handwriting while DERM's contains \"Builds a complete evidence-based routine\" and no budget rule at all, and engine_onboarding.py's eight captions contain the nine answers in plain English. So \"0.7 fewer products, £14 less\" is arithmetic on two paragraphs you typed, and \"89% recovered from public posts\" is a round trip. This is precisely the sin you retracted in §2b and were rewarded for retracting — the retraction is the single reason all five personas are reading you in good faith, and committing the same error twice does not cost you one number, it costs you the credibility that carries every other number in the repo. The demo spine rests on this stat; if it is challenged on stage, the whole 90 seconds is under question in front of a host whose stated religion is that trust is the scarce asset. Two compounding dangers: first, the fix may shrink the divergence from 5/6 to 3/6 or lower, and the demo script must be written against the honest number — which is why the symmetric re-run is scheduled before 11:00 and not after the freeze, so you are never choosing between an accurate demo and a rehearsed one. Second, the honest number might be BETTER — with the SPF and irritation constraints wired in from the extracted standard, Maya's baskets get more specific, not less — but you will only know in time to use it if the decontamination is the first thing you build rather than the last. Runner-up risk, worth naming in the runbook: five of the eight remaining fixes are frontend, and v1's lesson, stated by two personas, is that the unbuilt hero dies at 19:00. Hence the hard 14:30 freeze and the cache/*.json fallback, and hence the stated cut order — the brand screen goes, then 'do it for me instead', then the indifference band. The decontamination, the symmetric derm, the hard constraints and the queue do not go, under any circumstances.
